derivationRules.bookingReference: "b-" + review id; no matching booking row exists — see extract-seed.mjs
derivationRules.customerLogin: displayName lowercased, runs of spaces and hyphens replaced by "."
derivationRules.customerEmail: login + "@example.demo", except the one customer the prototype describes in full
derivationRules.verification: prototype boolean: true -> VERIFIED, false -> UNVERIFIED
derivationRules.money: prototype major units (cedis) x100 -> minor units (pesewas)

categories.name: Fitness & Movement
categories.blurb: Trainers, yoga and pilates teachers, movement and mobility coaches.

categories.name: Nutrition & Lifestyle
categories.blurb: Nutritionists, health and sleep coaches, lifestyle and weight support.

categories.name: Wellness & Therapy-adjacent
categories.blurb: Massage, mindfulness, mental wellbeing coaching, doulas and reflexology.

categories.name: Home & Elder Care
categories.blurb: Caregivers, home health aides, post-op companions and mobility assistants.

professionals.headline: Registered Nutritionist · Metabolic health
credentials: BSc Nutrition & Dietetics, University of Ghana
professionals.bio: I build eating plans that survive real Ghanaian kitchens and real budgets. Most of my clients come to me with a new type-2 diagnosis, a stubborn plateau, or a doctor’s note they did not understand.

services.name: Nutrition assessment (first visit)
services.description: Full dietary history, body composition, and a written plan you keep.

services.name: Follow-up consultation
services.description: Review of logs, plan adjustment, next targets.

services.name: Family meal-planning session
services.description: Cook-along planning for the whole household, in your kitchen or online.

services.name: Monthly accountability (4 sessions)
services.description: Four 30-minute check-ins plus message support between them.

professionals.headline: Strength coach · Return-to-fitness after 40
professionals.bio: I train people who have not lifted anything heavier than a laptop in a decade. We start embarrassingly light and you leave stronger than you were at thirty.

services.name: 1:1 personal training
services.description: One-to-one session at the studio in Osu or your building gym.

services.name: Home visit training
services.description: I bring bands, kettlebells and a mat to you.

services.name: 8-session starter block
services.description: Two per week for a month, with a written programme.

professionals.headline: Hatha & restorative yoga · Back care
professionals.bio: Slow, precise, unhurried yoga for people whose backs have opinions. Classes are small and nobody is asked to do anything their body has not agreed to.

services.name: Private yoga session
services.description: One-to-one, tailored to whatever is complaining that week.

services.name: Online restorative class
services.description: Live small-group class, up to six people.

services.name: Back care programme (6 weeks)
services.description: Six private sessions plus a short daily home sequence.

professionals.headline: Mat & reformer pilates · Post-natal
professionals.bio: Core work that is actually core work, not endless crunches. I see a lot of new mothers and a lot of runners who have been told to "strengthen the core" with no further instruction.

services.name: Reformer session
services.description: Private studio session on the reformer.

services.name: Mat pilates (online)
services.description: Live one-to-one mat class from home.

services.name: Post-natal return block
services.description: Six sessions, cleared-for-exercise clients only.

professionals.headline: Mobility & movement coach · Desk bodies
professionals.bio: Hips that do not hinge, shoulders that do not reach overhead, necks that live forward of the spine. That is my whole practice, and it is a large practice.

services.name: Mobility assessment
services.description: Screen of every major joint, with video and a routine you keep.

services.name: Follow-up mobility session
services.description: Progression and coaching on the routine.

services.name: Office team workshop
services.description: On-site session for up to twelve colleagues.

professionals.headline: Prenatal & post-natal fitness coach
professionals.bio: Safe, confident movement through all three trimesters and back out the other side. I work with your midwife where there is one, and I never guess.

services.name: Prenatal fitness session
services.description: One-to-one, adjusted to trimester and how the week has gone.

services.name: Post-natal rebuild
services.description: Gradual return, starting with breath and pelvic floor.

services.name: Birth-prep movement (3 sessions)
services.description: Positions, breathing and mobility for labour.

professionals.headline: Diabetes health coach · Habit change
credentials: National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach
professionals.bio: I do not hand out diets. I help people find the two or three changes they will still be making next year, and then I keep them honest about it.

services.name: Coaching intake
services.description: Where you are, what has failed before, what we will try first.

services.name: Fortnightly coaching call
services.description: Thirty minutes, log review, one change at a time.

services.name: Household session
services.description: With whoever cooks and whoever shops.

professionals.headline: Adult sleep coach · CBT-I informed
professionals.bio: Six weeks, a sleep diary and a lot of unglamorous consistency. I am not a doctor and I will tell you plainly when something needs one.

services.name: Sleep assessment
services.description: History, diary set-up and the first week’s plan.

services.name: Weekly sleep review
services.description: Diary review and schedule adjustment.

services.name: 6-week sleep programme
services.description: Assessment plus five weekly reviews.

professionals.headline: Weight & lifestyle coach · Shift workers
professionals.bio: Most of my clients work offshore rotations or long night shifts. Standard advice assumes three meals and a bedtime; mine does not.

services.name: Lifestyle intake
services.description: Rotation, sleep, food access, what is actually available to you.

services.name: Check-in call
services.description: Short, frequent, fits between shifts.

professionals.headline: Remedial & sports massage therapist
professionals.bio: Twelve years of shoulders that live at ear height. Deep tissue when it helps and gentle when it does not — I will tell you which one you need.

services.name: Remedial massage (60 min)
services.description: Focused work on one or two problem areas.

services.name: Full body massage (90 min)
services.description: Whole-body session, slower pace.

services.name: Home visit (60 min)
services.description: Table, linens and oils brought to you.

professionals.headline: Mindfulness & stress practitioner (MBSR)
professionals.bio: Eight weeks of MBSR, taught properly and without any mysticism. People arrive sceptical; the sceptics tend to be my best students.

services.name: Intro session
services.description: What MBSR is, what it is not, and whether now is the time.

services.name: 8-week MBSR course
services.description: Weekly group class plus one day of practice.

services.name: 1:1 practice support
services.description: For people already practising who are stuck.

professionals.headline: Mental wellness coach · Burnout & boundaries
professionals.bio: Coaching, not therapy — and I hold that line carefully. If what you bring belongs with a clinical psychologist, I will say so in the first session and help you find one.

services.name: Discovery session
services.description: Free. Whether coaching is the right thing at all.

services.name: Coaching session
services.description: One-to-one, structured, with between-session actions.

services.name: 6-session burnout block
services.description: Six sessions over three months.

professionals.headline: Birth & post-partum doula
professionals.bio: I am the person in the room whose only job is you. I do not replace your midwife and I do not make medical decisions — I make sure you understand the ones being offered.

services.name: Doula consultation
services.description: Free. Meet, ask everything, decide nothing.

services.name: Birth package
services.description: Two antenatal visits, on call from 38 weeks, birth attendance, one post-natal visit.

services.name: Post-partum visit (4 hrs)
services.description: Feeding support, rest cover, and a hot meal made.

professionals.headline: Reflexology & aromatherapy
professionals.bio: Fifteen years of feet. Relaxation first — I make no clinical claims and my clients come back because an hour on my table is an hour nobody can reach them.

services.name: Reflexology session
services.description: Full foot reflexology with a warm compress finish.

services.name: Aromatherapy massage
services.description: Blend chosen with you at the start of the session.

professionals.headline: Senior caregiver · Dementia experienced
professionals.bio: Sixteen years with older adults, eleven of them with dementia. I keep a written day-book for every client so the family always knows exactly how the day went.

services.name: Day care visit (4 hrs)
services.description: Personal care, meals, medication reminders, company.

services.name: Full day (8 hrs)
services.description: Full daytime cover with a written day-book.

services.name: Overnight cover (12 hrs)
services.description: Waking or sleeping night by arrangement.

professionals.headline: Home health aide · Chronic condition support
professionals.bio: I support people living at home with diabetes, COPD and heart failure — medication reminders, mobility, meals, and an eye on the things that change quietly.

services.name: Half day (4 hrs)
services.description: Personal care, meals, mobility and a written note.

services.name: Full day (8 hrs)
services.description: Full daytime support.

services.name: Escort to appointment
services.description: Door-to-door escort, waiting, and a summary afterwards.

professionals.headline: Post-operative companion & recovery aide
professionals.bio: The first fortnight after surgery is when most things go wrong at home. I do wound-site watching, mobility, meals and the pharmacy run, and I escalate fast.

services.name: Recovery day (6 hrs)
services.description: Daytime support through the early recovery window.

services.name: Discharge day package
services.description: Collection from hospital, settling in, first-night set-up.

professionals.headline: Mobility & transfer assistant
professionals.bio: Transfers, hoists, stairs and getting people safely out of the house again. A lot of my work is teaching families to do it without hurting themselves.

services.name: Mobility visit (3 hrs)
services.description: Transfers, walking practice and safe routine setting.

services.name: Family training visit
services.description: Teaching the household safe transfer technique.

services.name: Assisted outing (4 hrs)
services.description: Wheelchair-accessible outing with transport arranged.

reviews.body: Akosua rewrote my whole week of meals around what my mother already cooks. Six weeks in my fasting numbers are the best they have been since diagnosis.
reviews.professionalReply: Thank you Yaa — keep the Sunday prep going, it is doing the heavy lifting.

reviews.body: She read my lab results with me line by line instead of just handing me a leaflet. First time anyone has done that.
Very good plan and genuinely practical. Only note is that the first appointment ran slightly over and I had to rush off.
reviews.professionalReply: Fair point — I have moved first visits to a 75-minute slot because of feedback like this.

reviews.body: My wife and I did the family session together. It ended an argument we had been having for two years about rice.
Lost 7kg without ever once feeling like I was on a diet. She is very calm about slip-ups.
Good, thorough, evidence-based. Online sessions work well.
She coordinated directly with my endocrinologist. That never happens.
reviews.professionalReply: Always happy to — just ask and I will write to them.

reviews.body: I had not exercised in eleven years. Kwabena started me with a broomstick and I am now deadlifting my own bodyweight.
Comes to my building gym at 6am without fail. Never once cancelled.
Excellent trainer. The 8-session block is good value but book early, he fills up.
He is the first trainer who asked about my knee before writing the programme rather than after I complained.
Patient, funny, and does not shout. I dreaded it and now I look forward to it.
Twelve years of desk-hunched shoulders and Naa Adjeley has undone more in six weeks than physio did in six months.
Small class, very attentive. She noticed my knee was compensating before I did.
reviews.professionalReply: Glad it helped — keep the block under that knee in the seated poses.

reviews.body: The online restorative class is the only thing that gets me to sleep on Sunday nights.
Great teacher. Online class occasionally has audio lag on my connection.
Deeply kind and completely unpushy. Nobody is compared to anybody.
Nine months post-partum and Selorm got me back to running without the leaking nobody warns you about.
Very knowledgeable, studio is clean and quiet. Parking in Tema is the only annoyance.
I came for core strength for running and got a lesson in breathing I did not know I needed.
The assessment video he sent afterwards was genuinely useful. Routine takes eight minutes a day.
Ran the workshop for our whole office. Half the team have kept it up, which for our office is a miracle.
Good coach. Sometimes slow to reply to messages.
reviews.professionalReply: Noted — I have added a fixed message window at 6pm daily.

reviews.body: Efua trained me right through to 39 weeks and then straight back afterwards. She spoke to my midwife twice.
Made me feel strong at a point when I felt like a passenger in my own body.
The birth-prep sessions were worth every cedi. I actually knew what to do with my hips.
Kojo does not lecture. He asked me what I was willing to change and we started with exactly that one thing.
My HbA1c is down 1.4 points in eight months. My doctor asked what I had been doing.
Very good coach, very reliable. Online only, which did not suit me at first.
He included my husband in the sessions and that changed everything about how we shop.
The diary felt tedious for the first week and then suddenly the pattern was obvious. Sleeping through most nights now.
reviews.professionalReply: That first week is the tax everybody pays. Well done for sticking with it.

reviews.body: Night shifts had wrecked me. Six weeks later I have a schedule that actually survives the rota.
Helpful and clear. She told me plainly that part of my issue needed a GP, which I respected.
Understands offshore rotations, which no coach I have used before did.
Sensible advice, no gimmicks. Sessions are short and to the point.
Adwoa found the exact spot in my shoulder that three other people had missed. Slept like a stone that night.
reviews.professionalReply: Keep the doorway stretch going twice a day and it will hold.

reviews.body: Home visits are immaculate. Table, linens, everything, and she leaves the room as she found it.
Best sports massage in Accra, and I have tried most of them.
She talks you through exactly what she is doing and why. Never painful without warning.
Excellent therapist, books out weeks ahead though.
reviews.professionalReply: I release new slots every Sunday evening if that helps.

reviews.body: I finished the eight weeks a sceptic and now I sit for twenty minutes every morning. I cannot fully explain it.
Kofi is completely without woo. It is a course, with homework, and it works.
Very good teacher. The all-day session is a serious time commitment — plan for it.
Abena told me in session one that part of what I brought needed a psychologist, and helped me find one. Then we did excellent work on the rest.
Six sessions pulled me out of a burnout I had been in for two years.
Evening slots meant I did not have to explain anything to my employer.
Structured and useful. Homework between sessions is not optional, be warned.
Hannah was the calmest person in a very loud room. My husband says the same.
She never once told me what to do. She made sure I understood every option offered to me.
The post-partum visits saved me. She made food and let me sleep.
An hour where nobody can reach me. Yaa is worth it for that alone, and my feet feel new.
Lovely, relaxing, professional. She is clear that it is relaxation, not treatment, which I appreciated.
Grace has been with my mother for fourteen months. The day-book means I know exactly how every day went even from Kumasi.
We booked Grace for my father after his fall. Calm, unhurried, and he actually likes her, which is not nothing.
reviews.professionalReply: He is very good company. Tell him I said the stairs are still off-limits.

reviews.body: Sixteen years of experience shows in ten minutes. She anticipated things we had not thought about.
Overnight cover for three weeks while I travelled. Not one problem.
Emmanuel records my father’s blood pressure every visit and it goes straight to the doctor. Very organised.
Reliable and kind. Half-days work well for us.
He noticed my mother’s ankles swelling before anyone else did. That visit probably mattered a lot.
Mavis collected me from hospital and had the house ready. The first week would have been a disaster without her.
Very competent and watchful. Booked her for six days after my knee replacement.
Daniel taught my brother and me how to transfer our father properly. My back thanks him.
Good with the hoist and very safety-conscious. Outings have given my mother her weekends back.

customers.addressLine: 14 Nortei Ababio Loop, Airport Residential, Accra
customers.careSummary: Type-2 diabetes (2019). Monitored prostate. Fall in May 2026 — mobility improving.

bookings.customerNote: Bring the last two weeks of glucose readings.
Asked for the block under the left knee.

requests.note: Follow-up. Will send the glucose log beforehand.
Newly diagnosed pre-diabetes. Referred by Dr Adom at Nyaho.
Second family session — my mother will join this time.
Would like to start the monthly block.
Asked for the earliest slot available.

messages.body: Morning Kojo — ahead of Wednesday, could you send the glucose log? Even a photo of the notebook is fine.
Will do. The evening readings are still high on the days I eat late.
That is useful in itself. Let us look at the timing rather than the food on Wednesday.
Also — your last HbA1c came through from the clinic. It is down. We will go through it properly.
Shoulder is tight again. Any chance of a home visit on the 14th?
17:30 on the 14th works. I will bring the table — same room as last time?
Booked. Keep the doorway stretch going until then.
Day-book for Thursday is written up. He walked to the gate and back twice, no wobble.
He has asked me twice about the stairs. I have held the line.
Thank you Grace. Hold it a while longer.
Understood. I can add a second visit on Mondays if that would help while he is still unsteady.
No rush — let me know by Friday.
Requested the 18th at 08:30. Is the knee block still on hand?
It is. I will confirm the slot once I have moved a group class — by Tuesday at the latest.

notifications.body: Adwoa Serwaa confirmed your home visit on Fri 14 Aug at 17:30.
Grace Amponsah sent you two messages about Thursday cover.
How was your nutrition assessment with Akosua Mensah on 16 Jun?
Naa Adjeley Quaye has not yet confirmed 18 Aug at 08:30.
